required_reporting: Report applicable dimensions independently before any composite score.
comparison: When a valid reference exists, compare under documented comparable conditions. Assisted completion must remain visibly labeled and cannot be treated as independent mastery.
optimization: Prefer Pareto improvements that increase quality while reducing latency/resource/cost burden. Do not accept speed gains that materially reduce required quality or safety.
mastery: Requires benchmark-specific quality acceptance plus applicable performance, reliability, independence, and regression gates.
